base_setup_commands: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ca-certificates git curl golang-go libvips-dev pkg-config gcc libexpat1-dev libgsf-1-dev libfftw3-dev libcfitsio-dev libimagequant-dev libcgif-dev libexif12 libjpeg-dev libpng-dev libwebp-dev libpango1.0-dev libfontconfig-dev libtiff-dev librsvg2-dev libcairo2-dev libmatio-dev liblcms2-dev libopenexr-dev libopenjp2-7-dev liborc-0.4-dev
activation_command: export GOPATH=/root/go && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin:$GOPATH/bin && export CGO_CFLAGS_ALLOW=-Xpreprocessor
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export GOPATH=/root/go && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin:$GOPATH/bin && export CGO_CFLAGS_ALLOW=-Xpreprocessor && go version && pkg-config --modversion vips'

base_deps_installed: libvips-dev (8.14) with all transitive dev dependencies
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: none - dependencies installed via go mod download in setup_runtime
runtime_profile.notes: Go project using CGO to wrap libvips C library. Requires CGO_CFLAGS_ALLOW=-Xpreprocessor for building. libvips-dev requires numerous transitive development dependencies for full functionality including TIFF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, and other format support. Test files include golden tests and foreign tests for TIFF export.

notes: Base image debian:bookworm provides git and curl by default when golang-go and libvips-dev are installed. Go 1.19 from bookworm repos satisfies the go 1.15+ requirement. libvips-dev 8.14 satisfies the 8.10+ requirement. All libvips transitive development dependencies are explicitly installed to ensure CGO compilation succeeds. The project uses Go modules (go.mod/go.sum) for dependency management. CGO requires special flags for building.
